args.title: Triage issue 4405
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

In src/components/ExportButton.tsx, the export format is maintained via local React state initialized to `defaultFormat` ('csv'). When the user changes the export format and exports or navigates, the selection is reset because it is not persisted in localStorage or sessionStorage. As discussed in issue #4405, remembering the last chosen export format in the browser (e.g. via localStorage) would resolve this.
